components.name: method
values: mosaic platform | spheroids of mixed cell lines in suspension were treated with drugs for 24 hours then dissociated fixed and profiled with parse gigalab scrna-seq kit. snp-based deconvolution was used to assign cell lines. a total of 14 96-well plates were used each processed into 72-165 sublibraries producing 1.4 trillion reads from 153 million cells. filtering yielded 100.6 million cells passing minimal filters and 95.6 million passing full filters.
